build_knn_dynamic_graph: build a KNN-based dynamic graph from temporal feature tensors with optional VSS support
create_neigh_idx_semantic: create semantic neighbor indices from feature tensors using KNN with batch-aware shifting
build_NeighConv_layer: build a neighbor convolution layer that aggregates features using configurable modes and edge weights
build_xGN_module: build a hybrid CNN-GCN module with parallel or sequential graph convolution insertion
test_NeighConv_forward: test the NeighConv forward pass with feature tensors and neighbor indices for aggregation
